llm_response.reason: The site displays several scam characteristics: it offers luxury 'Max Mara' goods at drastic discounts of up to 96%, preys on consumer psychological triggers (urgency, massive savings), and mimics official branding yet provides no legitimate company or contact information. Cross-links to other suspicious sites reinforce its likely inclusion in a scam network. No established retailer sells luxury goods at such extreme discounts, confirming this is a fake online shopping scam.
